description:
XPENG is a leading smart technology company at the forefront of innovation, integrating advanced AI and autonomous driving technologies into its vehicles, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. With a strong focus on intelligent mobility, XPENG is dedicated to reshaping the future of transportation through cutting-edge R&D in AI, machine learning, and smart connectivity.

  

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a new graduate Software Engineer to join XPENG’s Computing Platform team. We build a unified compute platform that provides core AI infrastructure for autonomous driving, robotics, and intelligent cockpit applications.

  

 Our platform supports  batch and real-time streaming data processing at a scale of hundreds of millions of records per day . It processes data from files, datasets, lakehouse tables, and streaming sources, supporting multimodal workloads across images, videos, point clouds, and sensor streams. Key use cases include data mining , data cleaning, automated captioning and tagging, and embedding generation .

 Large-scale inference is another core focus of the team, spanning offline batch inference and online model serving. You will help build and optimize infrastructure for deploying and running multimodal and other AI models, including model deployment, request routing, CPU/GPU resource scheduling, autoscaling, and monitoring. The work focuses on improving inference throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency, while making it easier for algorithm teams to bring models into production.

  

 We are also developing intelligent platform capabilities through reusable agent skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). You will work alongside experienced engineers to build reliable, scalable systems, automate engineering workflows, and improve the developer experience.

  

 Job Responsibilities 

 
 
 Contribute to one or more of the following areas:

 
 
 Batch and real-time data processing: Build and improve distributed processing infrastructure for files, datasets, lakehouse tables, and streaming sources, enabling multimodal data mining, cleaning, automated captioning and tagging, and large-scale embedding generation.



 
 Distributed compute and inference: Develop capabilities for job management, model deployment, offline batch inference, and online model serving, including request routing, CPU/GPU resource scheduling, autoscaling, and performance optimization.



 
 Platform APIs and CLI : Develop and improve platform APIs and command-line tools for job submission, configuration management, status monitoring, and troubleshooting, making the platform easier to use and integrate with automated workflows.



 
 Intelligent platform capabilities: Develop reusable agent skills, MCP servers and tool integrations, and RAG-based features. Connect agents with platform APIs, data, and tools to support knowledge retrieval, job development, troubleshooting, and workflow automation.



 


 
 Work with experienced engineers to take scoped features through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration based on user feedback.



 
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in code reviews and technical discussions.



 
 Improve system observability, investigate issues, and use profiling and benchmarks to identify bottlenecks and validate improvements in reliability, throughput, latency, and resource efficiency.



 
 Apply AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation.



 
 Collaborate with platform, algorithm, and data teams to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.



 
  

 Basic Qualifications 

 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, completed or expected before the start date.



 
 Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, C++, or Go, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering. Willingness to learn and work with languages and tools used by the team.



 
 Foundational knowledge of operating systems, databases, networking, or distributed systems.



 
 Software development and debugging experience through academic projects, internships, research, or open-source contributions.



 
 Hands-on familiarity with AI-native software development workflows , using AI coding assistants or coding agents to understand codebases, implement and debug features, and develop tests. Ability to review generated code, reason about its behavior, and verify correctness through testing.



 
 Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies.



 
 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates.



 
  

 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 
 Distributed computing and streaming technologies such as Ray, Spark, Flink, or Kafka.



 
 Machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, model serving, or inference optimization.



 
 Backend API development, command-line tools, or developer tooling.



 
 Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms.



 
 SQL databases, caching systems, object storage, columnar data formats such as Parquet and Lance, or lakehouse technologies such as Apache Iceberg.



 
 LLM application development, including tool calling, MCP server development or integration, reusable agent skills, agent workflows, RAG, vector retrieval, or evaluation.



 
 Interest in AI infrastructure and its applications in autonomous driving and robotics.



 
  

 What do we provide: 

 
 
 A fun, supportive and engaging environment



 
 Infrastructures and computational resources to support your ML model development/research.



 
 Opportunity to work on cutting edge technologies with the top talent in the field.



 
 Opportunity to make significant impact on transportation revolution by the means of advancing autonomous driving



 
 Competitive compensation package



 
 Snacks, lunches, dinners, and fun activities



 
  

 The base salary range for this full-time position is $124,091-$210,000, in addition to bonus, equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status or marital status or any other prescribed category set forth in federal or state regulations.
